ashley: Quick pulse — dedicated capacity turn-up next week. Who owns procurement ETA for the H100 racks? We have reservations for 16 nodes but vendor pushed a partial ship. Need to know if reservations shift.

kevin: I'm owning procurement. Vendor confirmed 12/16 ships on 2025-05-20, remaining on 2025-06-03. Still waiting ASN for last batch. I'll upload PO and ASN once I have them.

maria: @kevin can you confirm serials will map to our reservation IDs? Last time we had mismatch and reservations failed.

kevin: They said yes but require our rack IDs. Sending list in a sec. Also cc'ing ops-bot to trigger inventory create.

ops-bot: Inventory ticket created: INV-2025-0821. ETA for ticket updates depends on ASN.

ram: FYI DC power upgrade window is Tues 5/19 02:00-06:00 PT. Ops said it'll be live but there may be a 10m outage on PDU 3. Consider shifting smoke tests.

sophie: Smoke tests currently scheduled for 5/20 10:00 PT. Can we move to 5/20 14:00 to avoid window? Also need to confirm L2 routing and VLAN tagging; pinging net-eng.

maria: For reservations: if we get 12 nodes earlier, can we start canary on 12 and add rest later? What config knobs do we need turned on?

ashley: Yes canary on partial capacity is fine. We need autoscaler turned off for initial rollout and manual balancer. Action items: kevin -> push ASN & rack IDs; sophie -> confirm smoke reschedule with net-eng; ram -> confirm DC window no impact to interconnect; maria -> create prompt set and perf smoke checklist. I'll update the milestone board.

kevin: ASN uploaded to INV-2025-0821, rack IDs in the ticket. ping me if mismatch.

sophie: net-eng confirmed VLANs ok but need one extra /29 for mgmt. Requesting approval from infra budget.

maria: Created checklist: tests pass: pod launch <20s, p99 latency <120ms, kv-cache warm within 50 tokens. Attaching quick run command:
```
./run_smoke.sh --cluster dedicated-turnup --nodes 12 --checks quick
```

ashley: Thanks all. We'll roll partial canary Mon 5/21 09:00 PT if items clear. If anything blocks before EOD Friday escalate in #incidents. :thumbsup:
